0.$description: Chart panes, full-bleed panels, terminal personality. Basis: Basement square geometry (S14).

radius.$description: Radius scale (craft-principles §4.1; design §3.3). A nested element uses parent radius − inset, clamped to ≥ 0 (CP 11; S33). Radius tracks material, not whim (CP 12). Presets may swap the whole scale (Terminal square, Zen +2) but never mix scales; that mapping is Phase 3 (PresetPersonality).

xs.$description: Inner chips, badges, checkboxes inside 6px controls with a 2px inset. [derived] concentric rule S33 (6 − 2).

sm.$description: Buttons, inputs, tooltips, base surfaces. Basis: Geist base/small/tooltip (S3).

md.$description: Toasts, drawers, small cards. Basis: Sonner toast, Vaul drawer (S10, S11).

lg.$description: Menus, popovers, modals, medium/large cards. Basis: Geist menu/modal (S3).

full.$description: Pills, avatars, segmented toggles. Basis: rounded-full is Basement's most used radius (S14).
